title: Drop - ObjectReference
content:
Member of: ObjectReference Script Drops this object from the container that it is in. Syntax: Function Drop(bool abSilent = false) native Parameters: - abSilent: If true, will not display an on-screen "X dropped" message if the container is the player. Default: False Return Value: None. Examples: ; Drops us from the container we are in Drop()
; Silently drops us from the container we are in Drop(true) See Also: - ObjectReference Script - DropObject - ObjectReference
